svg.aria-label: Method overview: the shape the carrier is fitted on from three sources (a shape you define, a TRELLIS.2 mesh, a captured real object), cut faces from two sources (real photographs, Gemini), canonical framing, two single-image priors, one cylindrical state, one reverse chain and the cuttable asset
svg.text: A shape and two or three cut faces per family, of different specimens → a product of two single-image diffusion priors over the slices of one cylindrical lattice. Every image is a real slice.
